purpose: Bind first-party Tengu/Wealthnow market-data architecture to the named Polygon upstream without inferring an exact current Free price_snapshot lineage that is not explicitly documented.

findings.claim: Tengu's generated public OpenAPI client published on 2026-07-19 records Polygon as an active external API vendor.
findings.evidence: tengu_v3_api_quotas is described as per-vendor quota telemetry including Polygon.

findings.claim: The same first-party OpenAPI generation explicitly describes U.S. equity intraday tape as FIRM's own Polygon capture.
findings.evidence: tengu_v3_tape_bars: intraday minute bars for one equity from FIRM's own Polygon capture (~10.5k tickers, extended hours included). Polygon capture is also named for index/options surfaces.

findings.claim: The same OpenAPI generation contains the Free-route-era fundamentals_price_snapshot and live stream ingest/status surfaces in the same FIRM API version.
findings.evidence: tengu_v3_fundamentals_price_snapshot exists in API version 2.87; stream_ingest_status exposes a provider field, but no public indexed example currently reveals its runtime value.

findings.claim: Current Wealthnow documentation still supports /api/market/quote/{ticker} as a Free live equity quote and explicitly calls fundamentals_price_snapshot its spec equivalent / the same question over OpenAPI/MCP.
findings.evidence: Current Quickstart/API Reference ties the legacy Free quote route to /api/v3/fundamentals/price_snapshot.

findings.claim: Current price_snapshot is coupled to a live upstream market-data layer rather than silently synthesizing a quote when upstream data fail.
findings.evidence: Current Market Data docs state bid/ask are served only during a session when the quote was set in that session; quote_as_of is the quote-change time; when every price source fails the route returns 503 price_feed_unavailable with vendor_error naming the failure.

findings.claim: Current Tengu/Wealthnow Terms permit normal API automation within controls but do not themselves prove the UTP/SIP classification.
findings.evidence: Terms cover the API and prohibit bots/scripts only when they burden the Service or bypass rate/access controls; they require compliance with exchange rules and say market data are supplied by third parties.

findings.claim: UTP rules provide a structurally compatible zero-end-user-cost API classification.
findings.evidence: UTP1APIS is a Real-Time Nonprofessional Uncontrolled Recipient at $1/month billable to the Vendor; external distribution must be authorized and recipients/reporting handled under UTP rules.

what_is_proven: Polygon was an active Tengu external vendor in the same public FIRM OpenAPI generation.
Tengu explicitly used Polygon capture for U.S. equity intraday tape.
Current Wealthnow Free live equity quote and price_snapshot remain supported and formally equivalent at the product/spec level.
Current price_snapshot uses live upstream quote/trade data with independent market-event timestamps and fails closed on upstream failure.
what_is_not_proven: No current first-party sentence found that explicitly says the exact Free fundamentals_price_snapshot bid/ask route is sourced from Polygon.
No public stream_ingest_status runtime response has been observed showing provider=polygon for the current live quote producer.
No provider-specific UTP1APIS/equivalent classification or vendor fee-absorption confirmation has been found.

polygon_to_utp_rule: If the exact current Free route is explicitly bound to Polygon's consolidated U.S. stock quote product, then Polygon's official consolidated stock/NBBO lineage can satisfy strict G9-A for Nasdaq Tape C; do not make that binding by inference.
unlocks_required: First-party Wealthnow/Tengu documentation, live metadata, or written provider confirmation explicitly binds Free /api/market/quote and/or fundamentals_price_snapshot equity bid/ask to Polygon's consolidated U.S. equities feed, or directly to CTA/UTP SIP/National NBBO.

Provider-specific confirmation that the exact single-nonprofessional automated Free API use is lawfully classified under UTP1APIS or an equivalent approved category and that Tengu/Wealthnow absorbs all UTP/exchange/vendor assessments so the end user owes $0 without subscription, balance, funding, activity, account-maintenance, or per-query monetary conditions.
